summary: Forge Institute is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit based in Little Rock, Arkansas, serving the energy sector. Core competencies are program management, project management, and grant application and administration, with some intelligence capability (ET-ISAC). Forge connects sectors that normally struggle to connect: it brings national lab and university expertise (Idaho National Laboratory, PNNL, UALR, UAF) to industry, especially rural and municipal electric utilities. In a typical award Forge applies, administers the grant, promotes participation, and manages the project, while a lab or university is the subrecipient or subcontractor that provides the technical content.
